description: The Plan screen’s *Start with 50 / 30 / 20*, for a document with no plan yet: half the take-home pay to needs, 30% to wants and 20% to saving, each share divided among the top-level categories by what went out under each over the last three months the ledger holds. Answers every category with its share, its part, what that comes to a month and why. `shares` changes any of them — {category: needs | wants | saving | none}, a category by id or name — and a category the starter cannot place has to be given one before anything is made. **Dry-runs by default**; `commit: true` makes the plan. Once there is one, `set_plan` changes it.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true makes the plan.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

shares.description: A top-level category (id or name) to the share it counts as: needs, wants, saving, or none to leave it out.

name: start_plan
title: Start a first plan with 50 / 30 / 20
